lines: Today’s shoppers are not just looking for a good product at a fair price.
They are also checking the ethics of the company that supplies the product or service.
The changing view of shoppers is clearly shown in their concerns about the companies.
For example, there is growing interest in labor, environment, and social responsibility.
Companies are under pressure to present not only a good financial result but also social and environmental results.
Companies need to respond to the pressure because shoppers are presenting their concerns in every way.
They boycott the stores or even sue companies.
Some international companies have experienced the anger of shoppers in recent years.
Each time, they have had to respond quickly to protect their honor and popularity.
This growing importance of ethical shopping is a trend that cannot be ignored.
It is not going to go away.
Ethical shoppers will continue to be a growing power around the world in the next few decades.
Therefore, it is better for companies to understand this trend and make efforts to deal with it.
